versions.content: A Flow Control frame is used in segmented 1:1 connections (see section 7.2.1.1). Thus, it cannot appear in a 1:n connection. It allows the receiver to send information to the sender. It is sent after reception of an FF-x and after the last CF of a block if no error occurred.
